notes.title: Typing Fingers - Enemy, Fully Released!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=s7_flGelWPs;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]We arrived at the end of the journey with Typing Fingers Enemy[/h3]

Thanks to everyone that supported us along the way of development. This release contains major bug fixes and the complete story of the game. You can try all of our levels in three game modes that have an increasing difficulty each, we adjusted every difficulty very carefully so anyone can choose how they want to play. 

Bugs fixed
- Neverending NPC spawning that didn't let you finish levels. 
- More VFX on explosions
- Now you can use backspace to cancel typing the current word (for example, cancel a long word and taking care of small missiles first)
- Difficulty Levels adjusted accordingly. 

If we add something extra or make corrections we'll let you know through Steam Community or our social media. 

[h2]ENJOY![/h2]

[b] By the way, If you are a complete touch typing beginner, we have you covered. Learn how to touch type with Typing Fingers. You can adjust the speed for your learning needs between 0 wpm (words per minute) up to 200 wpm.[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1450860/Typing_Fingers/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1258830/Typing_Fingers__Enemy/

notes.title: Small Update Nº5
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=zkIvln51O6c;full][/previewyoutube]

As you get closer to the end you'll be able to power up your Brain Ship to the maximum, it will turn purplish and will be able to resist more direct damage, multiple laser beams, more time to stop, and deadlier bombs. It's the only way to deal with all the amount of targets.

We are getting closer to full release, stay tuned for more updates of Typing Fingers.

notes.title: Small Update 4
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=rm_CW62wx14;full][/previewyoutube]

A few weeks ago we entered the last phase of development of Typing Fingers Enemy. We hope we can release a new build soon. We worked on the backgrounds of the last levels and now we are working on the last 3 bosses' combat systems.  We'll leave you a short video sneak peek with the Brain Ship with full upgrades and the new BG that players will be flying through.

notes.title: Typing Fingers Enemy - Steam Early Access Update #3
notes.content:
One of the goals we have is giving the player the feeling of traveling in the depths of space. Because that feeling of being in outer space is one of the best experiences we can have in a space-themed game. This is how we do it.

1. To build the backgrounds, we created a shader on Unity, that has different layer (images or textures) which overlap each other but they have different speed levels.

The material allows us to custom any layer speed whichever we want to reach our desired effect. For the time being, we are working with 4 layers: the main background and 3 layers over it which give the illusion of depth.

[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/061677b52cb86302354fd8740cf4a13c/345984cd6efb9a92-58/s2048x3072/f8301ba12816d1efa5358bf9e4ce6fe2923b8a86.png[/img]

2. Since each layer will be moving at a different speed, we created a function that is set up to do exactly the same so we didn't need to repeat the process 4 times.

[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/584cd0a3904ee0fd0e428b302d0049bb/345984cd6efb9a92-4a/s2048x3072/0045f042bdd9ab183bc3efe81ece61761da7f9b3.png[/img]

3. Here is how it looks in the inspector

[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/bd01e525a30fdaf5a4d602e252b39da6/345984cd6efb9a92-70/s1280x1920/3e05667a6f44bc0b3c38ed7976769e08bdc097e8.png[/img]

4. And finally the result in Unity.

[previewyoutube=MR9Rq3jgV-U;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Working on the Ace Mode
notes.content:
[h1][b]NEW YEAR, NEW CHALLENGES AND HOPEFULLY THE COMPLETE BUILD[/b][/h1]

[img]https://scontent.fclo1-2.fna.fbcdn.net/v/t1.0-9/133508352_222647772714815_8166047209428510404_o.jpg?_nc_cat=102&ccb=2&_nc_sid=9267fe&_nc_eui2=AeH1qieAqSZxxTKTGrLoO2T6FDMh_CIRXvQUMyH8IhFe9L8CrOYMBnJoeoFMBErre0o&_nc_ohc=F-TTbgqjR7QAX_OWMl3&_nc_ht=scontent.fclo1-2.fna&oh=7cca595062e12e89275731ff5231d281&oe=60232D7D[/img]

[h2]Holidays always pass in a blink of an eye and it's not late enough to wish you all a happy new year![/h2]  

It's been a long time since we haven't delivered an update of the early access. While we are still working on several bugs present on the MAC version, other parts of the team are working on defining the level of difficulty for each game mode. 

[previewyoutube=7Lh-EgguMw8;full][/previewyoutube]

We know it can be overwhelming to have multiple enemies on your screen at once but this will only pressure you to write the fastest and more accurate way you can. You just have to keep an eye on which ship will attack first or is closer to damage you.

[previewyoutube=lJ8-VulaV2k;full][/previewyoutube]

We also will possibly change the way the superbomb power works. Previously, once you launched the bomb it will erase most of your upcoming enemies but we think that it may have another kind of power like what if the bomb simplified the words you need to type instead of erasing all the enemies. That could be more interesting.

notes.title: Typing Fingers Enemy - Early Access
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=6roNpoD7BLA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1][b]UPDATE Nº1: WORKING ON FRIGATES AND BIGGER SHIPS[/b][/h1]

Hi everyone, first of all, THANK YOU, VERY MUCH, to every single player who believes in our game and has purchased our Early Access version we are deeply happy about it. Second of all, we are working hard to complete all the next levels that come after the Early Access. As you advance in the game you'll surely meet more complex ships with longer words and deadlier weapons and these ones we are trying are the frigates, they aren't the biggest ones but it doesn't mean you can take them lightly.

If you want to see more info on our development or want to follow us in other media, check these links out we will try to reply to you as soon as possible.
